svg.title: Operational layers and the inversion of specification
svg.desc: From Layer 1 to Layer 3, human structural specification is progressively stripped away (greyed out), expanding automated search from an isolated leaf slot to unconstrained cross-layer co-adaptation grounded by physical signoff oracles.

g.text: THE MOONSHOT: ZERO IMMUTABLE STRUCTURAL TEMPLATE
ZERO TEMPLATE: Cross-Layer Co-Design Synthesis Fabric
Unconstrained joint HW/SW, arithmetic, and interface co-adaptation
Container dissolved: cross-layer co-adaptation across SW and silicon ↑
Trapped by Memory Bandwidth Wall & Routing Congestion
Parameters automated: numerical optimization within frozen topology ↑
LOCALIZED POINT ASSISTANCE IN FROZEN LEGACY CONTEXT
